newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Bound Brook, N.J., Board of Ed..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
The Board of Education of the
Borough of Bound Brook
(County of Somerset)
New Jersey
School Bonds
(Bank-Qualified) (Callable) (Book-Entry-Only Bonds)
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Board Secretary
of The Board of Education of the Borough of Bound Brook, in
the County of Somerset, New Jersey at the Board's offices,
at 133 West Maple Avenue, Bound Brook, New Jersey 08805-1330
on Tuesday
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the following Bonds of
the School District due (subject to prior redemption) on
July 15 in each of the years as follows:
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only in the
form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount
of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable
at the option of the Board in accordance with the terms set
forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Board will furnish
Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Wilentz, Goldman &
Spitzer, P.A., Woodbridge, New Jersey.
The Bonds will be dated July 15, 1997 and will bear
interest at the rate or rates per annum specified by the
successful bidder in accordance with the terms set forth in
the full Notice of Sale, payable on July 15, 1998 and semi-
annually thereafter on the fifteenth day of January and July
in each year until maturity or earlier redemption.
Each proposal submitted must specify the rate or rates of
interest per annum to be borne by the Bonds and the rate or
rates named shall be in multiples of one-eighth (1/8) or
one-twentieth (1/20) of one (1%) per centum. If more than
one rate of interest is named, no interest rate named for
any maturity may be less than the interest rate named for
any prior maturity and not more than one rate of interest
may be named for the Bonds of the same maturity. There is no
limitation on the number of rates of interest that may be
named. No proposal will be considered that offers to pay an
amount less than the total principal amount of Bonds offered
for sale or under which the total loan is made at an
interest cost higher than the lowest net interest cos
the Board of Education under any legally acceptable
proposal. Each proposal submitted must specify the purchase
price for the Bonds, which shall be not less than $3,930,000
nor more than $3,931,000. The Bonds shall be awarded to the
bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest
net interest cost. Such net interest cost shall be computed,
as to each bid, by adding the total interest cost to
maturity in accordance with such bid and by deduction
therefrom of the amount of premium bid, if any. If two or
more bidders offer the same lowest net interest cost, the
Bonds will be sold to one of such bidders selected by the
undersigned by lot from among all such bidders. The
purchaser must also pay an amount equal to the interest on
the Bonds accrued from the dated date of the Bonds to the
date of payment of the purchase price of the Bonds.
The right is reserved to reject all bids, and any bid not
complying with the terms of this notice will be rejected.
Each bidder is required to deposit a certified,
treasurer's or cashier's check payable to the order of THE
BOARD OF EDUCATION OF THE BOROUGH OF BOUND BROOK, IN THE
COUNTY OF SOMERSET in the amount of $78,600 drawn upon a
bank or trust company, and such check must be enclosed with
the proposal.
The full Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official
Statement and the bid forms are available by contacting the
Board Secretary at The Board of Education of the Borough of
Bound Brook, 133 West Maple Avenue, Bound Brook, New Jersey
08805-1330, (908) 271-2833 or the Board's Bond Counsel, Lisa
Gorab, Esq., Wilentz, Goldman & Spitzer, P.A., (908) 855-
/s/ Mark Albert
Board Secretary
DATED: July 3, 1997
(From The Bond Buyer)
